items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: Harold Dejon. He's a sax player, he must be young.

ctx.x: Harold Dejon. He's a sax player, he must be young. No, but this Dejon, he had one son, but he died just some time ago. I don't think he was a musician either. He's a sax player. Probably a relative, something like that.

There is a Lionel here playing drums, and his last name begins with a T, working out as much as Billy and the Dee Pierce. Could be, he was an old timer. He's an old timer, he's just starting back. He could look that good. Billy was a, what was Billy's maiden named Goodson, she's from Pensacola. Isn't that right, Bill? Yeah.
